messages:
samantha: heads up — deploy-bot just blocked the eu-west promotion for payments-service.
samantha: preflight failure: chart dependency 'payments-common' bumped to 2.1 but our promoted chart still expects 2.0.
deploy-bot: preflight-check failed -> dependency-check: payments-common required: \"2.1\" available: \"2.0\"; job: preflight-promotion-1492; logs: https://ci.internal/build/1492 :warning:
tyler: ah ok. did the cross-chart bump land in the same PR? was that merged earlier today?
lee: it was merged in a different repo last night — ops-sync didn't update the lockfile before promotion.
maria: can we promote a patch that keeps payments-common at 2.0 for eu-west only? or is that risky for downstream consumers?
ops-jen: regional override is possible with a values overlay, but expects a manual values file and a dry-run.
samantha: we need a quick decision: either hold promotion and assemble minimal release notes, or hotfix the chart to be compatible with 2.1 back-compat.
tyler: back-compat fix might be ~2-3h + validation. holding is faster but delays release window for other regions.
lee: if we do values override, we can run:
```
helm upgrade --install payments-service ./charts/payments --namespace prod-eu --values values/eu-west-override.yaml --set dependency.payments-common.version=2.0 --dry-run
```
lee: but we'd still need a manual approval in the deploy flow.
maria: I'm leaning values override + patch release notes: note that eu-west uses legacy payments-common 2.0 and will be reconciled next cycle.
release-bot: created PR #912 to add eu-west values overlay and notebook for postpromote reconciliation.
samantha: ok. plan: 1) hold global promotion (don't promote other regions until we confirm) 2) tyler + lee apply values/eu-west-override + run dry-run 3) ops-jen approves manual promote for eu-west 4) maria drafts short release note snippet stating the temporary override and the follow-up reconciliation
tyler: on it. i'll run the dry-run now and share logs.
tyler: dry-run shows successful template render, but preflight still flags dependency mismatch in global checks. need deploy-bot to skip global dependency check for regional override.
ops-jen: i can patch the promotion job to respect a regional-override flag for this run. patching pipeline now.
ops-jen: patched -> deploy job param: --allow-regional-overlay=true
deploy-bot: promotion blocked -> re-evaluating with flags: allow-regional-overlay=true -> regional promote allowed for prod-eu (eu-west). continuing.
lee: promoted eu-west successfully. logs: https://ci.internal/promote/7443 :tada:
samantha: great. maria, can you drop that release note into the release draft? keep it 1-2 bullets.
maria: added note: \"eu-west promotion used temporary values overlay to preserve payments-common v2.0; scheduled reconciliation with payments-common 2.1 in next maintenance window.\" linking PR #912 and the promote run.
release-bot: release draft updated: https://release.internal/drafts/2026-03-21-quick-patch
samantha: ok team — we'll follow up with a proper compatibility patch next sprint. thanks for the quick turn.
lee: postmortem: small ops gap: ops-sync didn't refresh chart.lock after cross-repo bump. i'll add a premerge CI gate to run `helm dependency update` and verify lock consistency.
tyler: sounds good. closing thread after release notes merged.
release-bot: release-notes merged and published to internal changelog.
